notes: Slow, melancholy-hopeful piano/strings piece. Use for the cold open / hook and for reflective narration (Morgan's hard early years, the wagoner's lash, the long road to Cowpens).
Long-form driving orchestral build with strings and drums, defiant character. Use as a tension bed for the Saratoga riflemen sequence and for extended build-ups before a battle turn.
Hard-driving percussion-forward war theme ('War' mood tag on incompetech). Use under the musket-volley / firing-line action beats and the Cowpens double envelopment.
Short colonial-era fife-and-drum-corps motif. Use as a period-flavored marching/interlude cue (militia forming up, camp scenes, chapter-break bumper) — good for a 1-minute chapter card.
Epic building orchestral piece with a choral brass swell near its climax. Use as the tension-to-climax cue for the Cowpens 'come get us' feigned retreat and the final charge.
Big dramatic cinematic drums, triumphant character. Use for the Cowpens victory beat and Morgan's promotion/legacy segment.
Massed ragged musket volley (26 staggered shots + low rumble bed), synthesized. For firing-line volley shots.
Single rifle/musket crack with faint echo tail, synthesized. For sniper/skirmisher single-shot beats (e.g. Timothy Murphy at Saratoga).
Cannon blast: sub-bass boom + noise crack + rumbling tail, synthesized.
Accelerating military snare roll into a final accent hit, synthesized. For countdown-to-battle / reveal beats.
Bandpass-swept noise transition swoosh, synthesized. For title cards and chapter transitions.
Low resonant thud with a knock transient, synthesized. For a stake/flag/musket-butt hitting the ground.
Four-beat accelerating horse-gallop pattern (dragoon/cavalry charge), synthesized. For Washington's/Tarleton's cavalry at Cowpens.
Layered multi-voice shout/cheer swell, synthesized. Optional — for the Cowpens victory moment.
